article.title: Presentment of cheque to charge any other person.
article.content: A cheque must, in order to charge any person except the drawer, be presented within a reasonable time after delivery thereof by such person.
article.html:
73Presentment of cheque to charge any other person.

Section 73 · Chapter V · page 18 of the Act

A cheque must, in order to charge any person except the drawer, be presented within a reasonable time after delivery thereof by such person.

73Presentment of cheque to charge any other person.

Section 73 · Chapter V · page 18 of the Act

A cheque must, in order to charge any person except the drawer, be presented within a reasonable time after delivery thereof by such person.
